info.title: CloudsForge public API
info.description: Generated from the verified route table in @cloudsforge/sdk. Every operation cites the file of the owning service that registers it. Paths are as the GATEWAY serves them: uniformly versioned under /v1, which four of the eight services do not do themselves.
